original_value: Compact removable flash storage designed for everyday document transfer, photo backups, and lightweight portable archiving. Features a retractable USB-C connector, matte polymer shell, and onboard status indicator. Suitable for laptops, tablets, and smartphones with USB-C data support; optimized for quick file copying rather than enterprise encryption or high-endurance workloads.
